snippet.title: Gang of Frogs - Official Playtest Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Playtest Trailer for Gangs of Frogs, the third-person action co-op shooter developed by Aska Studios. Players will sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter. Gang of Frogs is coming soon to PC (Steam), with sign ups for the upcoming playtest are available now on Steam.
